source.note: Wave-1 row 205 named Kenney Mini Arcade `vending-machine`: a small red snack box with a dark window and no visible stock. Kenney's City Kit Commercial, City Kit Roads and Furniture Kit have no vending machine. This CC0 MagicaVoxel soda machine (OBJ, no scenery) reads as a drinks machine: tall box, lit window of bottles on six shelves, a button column and the pickup slot at the bottom. Scaled to 1.83 m it is 0.87 m wide but 1.03 m deep (deeper than a real ~0.7 m machine; fixed proportions). Front (window) faces +Z. Static, no clips. Colours (indigo): white casing, red side panels, the window lit warm (`display` is the script's practical with threshold -0.25 so it reads lit at night), bottles in accent, moon, sky and skin.
